name: Muka
method: Equal-weighted, 30 holdings, paper index only (no real money). Return is the average of the holdings' daily returns, so it behaves as if rebalanced daily. Prices adjusted for dividends.
rules: The board meets on the first Monday of each month.
At most 3 swaps per meeting, and no more than 8 holdings in any one theme.
A holding can be dropped when its trend has failed (below its 50-day and 200-day averages) at two month-end checks in a row, or when its theme story breaks.
A replacement comes from the bench and must be in an uptrend at the meeting. Each swap is written to the log with a reason.
Every change takes effect at the close of the meeting day and is never back-dated.

board.text: Founding portfolio: 30 holdings across 7 themes. Growth engines (AI compute, platforms, power) balanced by defensives, healthcare, financials and hard assets so one bad theme cannot sink the index.
